native_scan.derivative_note: SHA-256 identifies the reviewed 300-dpi page raster generated from the Philco PDF, not the publisher PDF bytes.

milestones.title: Power and heater source review
milestones.summary: Cross-checked three filter/return groups, four documented heater interconnections and two #30 40 Ω/lamp shunt groups; confirmed #26:a on the first B+ group. AC endpoints, rectifier anode and complete line/heater path remain open.

milestones.title: Output-stage source review
milestones.summary: Cross-checked the 7C6 plate, 50L6 grid/cathode, output-transformer primary and both speaker-secondary groups. #22/#25 routes and electrical transformer/speaker models remain open.

milestones.title: RF and converter source review
milestones.summary: Reviewed the p.38 antenna, loop, tuning, oscillator and 7A8 region. No new RF net was promoted: the 7A8 symbol-to-socket crosswalk and winding/gang terminal assignments need stronger source confirmation.

milestones.title: IF source review
milestones.summary: Cross-checked the three existing #12/#14 plate/grid memberships. Complete winding endpoints, 7B7 screen/cathode, trimmer and AVC routes remain open.

milestones.title: Detector/AVC and netlist integration review
milestones.summary: Rechecked four detector/audio conductor groups and the existing upper-diode symbol-level link. #17 lower branch, diode socket-pin assignment and full AVC/return routing remain open.

milestones.title: 50L6 cathode-bypass trace reconciliation
milestones.summary: Added capacitor #22 terminals to the cathode and B− net review from the dedicated v0.36 native-scan trace. The output transformer, #25 route, and full output model remain open.

milestones.title: Power and AC-line symbol-level closure
milestones.summary: Traced plug conductors, #16 switch, #31 line capacitor, #30 40/80-ohm sections, #32 pilot-lamp shunt, 35Z3 plate feed, B-minus return, and all five heaters. Pin/lug crosswalks remain open; no factory graph memberships were added.

milestones.title: Output bypass and IF primary supply-end trace
milestones.summary: Source-traced #25 across filtered B+ and B−, and #12/#14 primary supply ends to filtered B+. Screen-glyph routing is recorded without assigning socket pins; other IF/AVC/output model gaps remain open.

milestones.title: Second IF AVC load and detector return trace
milestones.summary: Added upper #14 secondary/#17 upper endpoint group and #17 lower return endpoint from the native page-38 scan. The linked upper 7C6 diode remains an unnumbered glyph; full AVC and socket crosswalk remain open.

milestones.title: First IF secondary return and grid-return resistor trace
milestones.summary: Traced #12 secondary return to B− and both #13 grid-return resistor ends to the #12 secondary/grid node and B−. Pin/winding crosswalks and IF model parameters remain open.

milestones.title: RF input and loop-operation ground trace
milestones.summary: Added the source-traced 7A8 signal-input conductor through the upper #3 loop terminal, RF gang #4 and aerial compensator #5, plus their explicit loop-mode chassis grounds. The lower loop/#2 winding map and rest of the converter remain open.

milestones.title: Built-in loop and aerial-transformer interface trace
milestones.summary: Traced both #2 winding endpoints, the lower #3 loop connection, external ANT input, #1 bypass path and its loop-mode chassis ground. Transformer parameters and the rest of the converter remain open.

milestones.title: 7A8 oscillator return endpoint trace
milestones.summary: Traced lower #9 resistor and #11 capacitor endpoints to the B− return rail. Their opposite ends, #4 gang, #6–#10 network and 7A8 socket-pin crosswalk remain open.
Traced the shared screen lead between V1:5 (7A8 G3/G5) and V2:3 (7B7 G2). Upstream supply and measurement conditions remain open.
